images.title: Draw a lift for the sum
images.purpose: Show that a lift picture turns +105 + (+55) into one upward move: start at 105, go up 55, reach +160.
images.composition: One vertical line centred with a single upward arrow, large dots, wide white margins.
images.exact_structure: One vertical line with a grey #6B7280 ground line at 0 at the bottom. A teal #0072B2 dot at +105 and an amber #E69F00 dot at +160 above it, joined by one reddish purple #CC79A7 upward arrow. Exactly 1 ground line, 2 dots, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
an arrow pointing down, or the end dot below the start dot
images.takeaway: Draw the start, the move and the end to see the answer.
images.description: A vertical line with the ground at 0, a teal dot at +105, an upward arrow labelled +55, and an amber dot at +160.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the start, the move and the end, then say the sum.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
